accuracy_policy.drop_definition: Same-seed, same-checkpoint, same-preprocessing author-code reference minus native accuracy
accuracy_policy.precision: Unrounded accuracy or exact correct/sample counts
accuracy_policy.overall: Any structural failure or metric drop > 3.0pp fails; any metric with 1.5 < drop <= 3.0pp requires review; pass only if all four metrics drop <= 1.5pp and all structural gates pass
accuracy_policy.review_action: Investigate implementation/data/checkpoint/stage-seeding differences. Review and failure block efficiency measurements and merge acceptance. Abnormally low performance is an implementation concern, not silently accepted as seed variation.
